ranked_offers.name: Z.ai: GLM 5.2
ranked_offers.recent_activity: Z.ai の大規模推論モデル GLM 5.2 が OpenRouter で無料提供。1M コンテキストのテキストモデルで、長期的なエージェント作業に向く。
suspicion_reasons: OpenRouter :free variant with $0 pricing, tier S frontier model; standing free tier with rate limits.

ranked_offers.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
ranked_offers.recent_activity: DeepSeek V4 Flash の再ポスト訓練版。1M コンテキストの MoE で推論・ツール呼び出し・構造化出力に対応し、コーディングやエージェント業務に強い。NanoGPT では 入力 $0.14 / 出力 $0.28 per 1M と超低価格。
ranked_offers.operational_evidence: official docs / pricing fetch verified this run
suspicion_reasons: Paid ultra-low router price with no free allowance; cheap paid access via a third-party router.

ranked_offers.name: DeepSeek: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
ranked_offers.recent_activity: 同じ DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 を OpenRouter 経由で利用。13B アクティブ / 284B 総パラメータの MoE で 1.3M コンテキスト、入力 $0.08 / 出力 $0.18 per 1M と NanoGPT よりやや安い。
suspicion_reasons: Paid OpenRouter route at ultra-low verified price ($0.08/$0.18), not a free offer.

ranked_offers.name: MiMo V2.5
ranked_offers.recent_activity: Xiaomi の MiMo V2.5。全モーダル（テキスト・画像・動画）理解でツール呼び出し・構造化出力・Web 検索に対応し、最大 1M コンテキスト。NanoGPT では 入力 $0.14 / 出力 $0.28 per 1M。
ranked_offers.operational_evidence: official docs / pricing fetch verified this run
suspicion_reasons: API本体は0.14/0.28ドルの有料で、無料アクセスはコンシューマ画面のみ。

ranked_offers.name: Xiaomi: MiMo-V2.5
ranked_offers.recent_activity: 同じ MiMo V2.5 を OpenRouter 経由で利用。オムニモーダルでエージェント性能が高く、推論コストは約半分との主張。入力 $0.14 / 出力 $0.28 per 1M。
suspicion_reasons: Paid API at ultra-low $0.14/$0.28 per M tokens; tier S benchmark but still paid.

ranked_offers.name: Thinking Machines: Inkling
ranked_offers.recent_activity: Thinking Machines のオープンウェイト MoE、Inkling（975B 総 / 41B アクティブ）を OpenRouter で無料提供。マルチモーダルで生成用途に設計されており、フロンティア級を無料で試せる貴重な経路。
suspicion_reasons: OpenRouter :free variant with $0 pricing and daily-resetting rate limits; tier A model with strong benchmarks.

ranked_offers.name: NVIDIA: Nemotron 3 Ultra
ranked_offers.recent_activity: 同じ Nemotron 3 Ultra を OpenRouter の無料変種で利用。NVIDIA 公式トライアルの stale とは別に、OpenRouter 経由なら現在検証済み。550B MoE のフロンティア級を無料で試せる。
suspicion_reasons: OpenRouter :free variant of a frontier-class reasoning model with $0 verified price and recurring daily quota.

ranked_offers.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
ranked_offers.recent_activity: DeepSeek V4 Flash の本体。1M コンテキスト・最大出力 384K の効率最適化 MoE で、高速・高スループット用途向き。推論・ツール呼び出し・構造化出力対応、入力 $0.14 / 出力 $0.28 per 1M。
ranked_offers.operational_evidence: official docs / pricing fetch verified this run
suspicion_reasons: Paid ultra-low router price (0.14/0.28 per 1M) well below typical DeepSeek flash pricing; cheap paid access, not free.

ranked_offers.name: Ling 3.0 Flash
ranked_offers.recent_activity: inclusionAI の Ling-3.0-flash（124B MoE / 5.1B アクティブ）を NanoGPT 経由で利用。トークン効率に特化し、ツール呼び出し対応。入力 $0.075 / 出力 $0.22 per 1M。
ranked_offers.operational_evidence: official docs / pricing fetch verified this run
suspicion_reasons: Paid ultra-low router price for an open Ling model; cheap paid access via a third-party router.

ranked_offers.name: Ling-3.0-flash

facts.pricing_text: Aider v0.86.0 (Latest), released this 09 Aug 17:42 Aug 9, 2025: Added support for all GPT-5 models. Added support for Grok-4 via xai/grok-4 and openrouter/x-ai/grok-4 model names. Added support for gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17 model, by Tamir Zahavi-Brunner. /clear now prints “All chat history cleared.” so you know it worked, by Zexin Yuan. /undo output now shows only the first line of each commit message, making it easier to read. Added support for openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2 model, by Jack Harrington. Display model announcements with no-arg /model command. Fixed an issue where new settings for an existing model didn't replace the old ones, by Andrew Grigorev. Fixed analytics to support the latest PostHog SDK event-capture API. Bumped dependencies to pick up latest litellm==1.75.0. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

v4.1.13 released 22 Aug 20:23; SDK v0.0.78 released 22 Aug 23:58; Desktop v0.0.16 released 22 Aug 23:45; CLI v3.0.57 (Latest) released 23 Aug 00:04; v4.1.12 released 21 Aug 22:39; v4.1.11 released 21 Aug 05:30. v4.1.11: Show the billed cost for Cline gateway usage. Refresh the model catalog, which adds AMD, Arcee, Echo, Jalapeno, Kosmik, LLM Gateway, RunInfra, and SCNet as providers and updates model lists, pricing, and per-provider default models across the board. Point provider signup links at each provider's API key page instead of a generic landing page. Desktop v0.0.15: The composer's model selector now leads with Recommended and Free tiers (Subscribed and Free on ClinePass), labeled by display name with descriptions, instead of an alphabetized list of raw model ids. Usage now displays the billed gateway cost. Fixed ClinePass not being recognized as OAuth-managed in the chat credential gate. SDK v0.0.76: Provider model lists now carry featured tiers (Recommended/Free, and Subscribed/Free for ClinePass) plus model descriptions, served from the SDK with a cached recommended-models feed and a bundled offline fallback. Gateway usage now displays the billed cost.
